author: Thomas Zachmann
tagline: A CronJob with its own identity, verified archives to S3, and a restore you have actually rehearsed.
blurb_title: A CronJob that logs in with its ServiceAccount, verifies the snapshot and writes it to S3 – and a restore drill on a throwaway cluster
blurb_1: This guide is in progress. Planned: What a Raft snapshot is, and why there is no inspect; Policy and Kubernetes auth role for the snapshot job; The CronJob: save, verify, upload to S3 (MinIO); Retention and staleness check; Restore drill on a kind cluster: -force and two key sets; What went wrong; Operation: keys apart from snapshots, alerting.
blurb_2: Prerequisites: S3-compatible target in the cluster (MinIO) or external.
